reason: Retain the measured45-file database lifecycle as one authority at this exact membership. Retained copying, physical page admission, verified recovery, discard on failure, sealing and atomic publication share one transaction and restart lifecycle; extracting a forwarding storage service would split that authority. The migration package owns its pinned route and sorter inventory; fseffect and platform adapters own filesystem primitives. Source-derived scratch facts remain in the upgrade Plan, while db owns private file admission and publication. Focused current-tree contracts cover actual SQLITE_FULL with original and recovery readable, obsolete-index rebuilding, chunk coverage without independent temporary B-trees, amplified rechunking, final WAL opening and crash/seal/copy failures. Further membership growth renews review.
